system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: A cycle begins by choosing an active node together with a scope—the set of nodes the worker is permitted to edit—and a directive fixing the kind of edit expected
system_prompt_style.note: Per-cycle kernel-assembled scope/directive; no prompt file shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Workers propose statements, dependencies, decompositions, and proof edits, and can also request different scope in the face of problems.
env_context_strategy.note: Tablet git repo plus paper context; mechanism not stated explicitly.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the Lean sources are recompiled from scratch in isolation, against a workspace the worker cannot tamper with

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The worker returns a single edit to the Tablet, and the supervisor checks it deterministically before any other agent sees it: a shape check that the touched files have the required form
edit_primitive.note: Node files (LaTeX statement block + Lean declaration) are written whole; primitive not specified.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Within a phase the supervisor advances the run in cycles, the pipeline of Figure 5.
loop_primitives.note: Deterministic kernel-driven cycle: worker edit -> isolated Lean build/axiom check -> verifier lanes -> reviewer; theorem-stating phase precedes formalization.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Trellis operates over a proof tablet: a directed acyclic graph (defined by Lean import structure).
planning_granularity.note: The tablet DAG is the persistent progress ledger; StuckMathAudit also writes a recovery plan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: In Trellis, a reviewer agent directs the actions of a worker agent, but they are both tightly constrained by a deterministic kernel
multi_agent_topology.note: Reviewer + worker + four/five verifier lanes + audit agent, all adjudicated by the kernel.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The supervisor keeps exactly one agent request in flight at any moment and commits a checkpoint only at the close of the cycle.
delegation_mechanism.note: Kernel routes control between fixed roles; no new agent instances spawned for subtasks are described.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: these settled statements are offered for human review and no changes to them are allowed during formalization without reopening human review
human_in_loop.note: Human ratifies the semantic-closure Lean shapes at the phase transition.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: a kernel—a state machine, written in Rust and specified in TLA+, that owns all protocol state and makes every decision

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: a deterministic kernel (leveraging durable long-term state memory) that owns semantic authority of the process
long_term_memory.note: Tablet git repo and reference/ deviation files persist across cycles; cross-run memory not described.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Worker edits accepted by the deterministic supervisor are committed as checkpoints (git commits) to the Tablet git repository; rejected edits are rolled back.

self_verification.evidence_quote: all Lean builds are carried out by the deterministic supervisor in an isolated environment the editing agent doesn't have access to
self_verification.note: Lean build + axiom check = harness-run verification; verifier lanes are independent LLM judges; StuckMathAudit advises.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: the supervisor discards it and re-issues the same request as a fresh attempt, retrying a bounded number of times within the cycle before escalating to the reviewer

rollback.evidence_quote: the reviewer can choose (or be forced to choose) LastClean, a git rewind of the tablet to the last clean checkpoint

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The kernel will not mark a run Complete unless every paper target and every declaration in this closure stands in its approved state with no open blocker
termination_condition.note: DONE is a reviewer directive legal only when blockers=0; stall thresholds trigger StuckMathAudit/rewind rather than halting.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: using 35% of the weekly usage budget of a ChatGPT Pro subscription
cost_controls.note: Budget described as an aim ('modest budget'); no explicit in-harness cap mechanism reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: dispatching each stochastic agent in a sandbox, and running the authoritative Lean build through an isolated checker the agents cannot reach
execution_isolation.note: Checker is a long-running supervisor-owned server reached over a local unix socket; sandbox type unspecified.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Each worker burst is granted a bounded scope: the set of already-present nodes it may edit that cycle.
filesystem_access.note: Kernel rejects any burst whose file delta touches a node outside its authorized set; only worker can write the Tablet.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Before dispatch the kernel rejects any out-of-envelope or out-of-cone authorization, an empty authorization under a restructuring mode or a non-empty one under local

tracing.evidence_quote: we release the full end-to-end autoformalization repo in which every cycle-checkpoint of the process is visible

replayability.evidence_quote: it is possible to inspect every edit made by the Trellis worker in the formalization process
replayability.note: Checkpoints are inspectable; no replay runner described.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: It also provides a way of optimizing and benchmarking the fully automatic part of autoformalization
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark runner described as shipped; evaluation is case studies on two papers.

guardrails.evidence_quote: after dispatch it rejects any burst whose file delta touches a node outside its authorized set
guardrails.note: Shape check, axiom check, scope guards block edits; verifier-lane gates block acceptance.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We present Trellis: an autoformalization system that leverages LLM agents in a deterministically constrained workflow to enforce incremental progress in Lean autoformalization tasks

open_source.note: A source repo is cited [Pegden(2026c)] but no licence is stated in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Trellis has also been run successfully with Opus 4.7 max and Gemini 3.1-pro preview in various roles.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our Trellis implementation sits in a kernel of (at time of writing) 35k lines of Rust code, supported by another 20k lines of python plumbing
primary_artifact.note: Coded from the paper; no pinned repo version available.

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date; no release tags available.

pinned_version.note: No repo commit available in evidence.
